geo_provisional.description: All boundary/key-area geometry derived from repository PROV-* provisional boundaries (sourced to official announcement 2026-05-09 / SRC-2026-BJ-GH-QUAL-PREANNOUNCEMENT). The three key-area ANNOUNCED areas (Zhongzhiyuan 192.1 ha, AI Origin Community 104.3 ha, Dazhongsi 72.0 ha; total 368.4 ha) are taken verbatim from the official announcement; our polygons are agent_inferred_from_public_data, low-confidence provisional_rough approximations, NOT official redlines. Precision-sensitive areas recomputed on official geometry arrival.

area_recalculation.description: All precision-sensitive area metrics recomputed from official polygons on arrival.

far_assumed.description: FAR 1.0 is a DESIGN-SCENARIO ASSUMPTION (planning reference value), not an approved control indicator and not a verified planning metric. Under this scenario, implied total floor area ≈43,609,232 m² (site_area × FAR 1.0) — scenario illustration only. Accordingly both floor_area_ratio and total_floor_area are declared status=unknown with value=null in metrics.json. Replace with the approved FAR and recompute all derived floor-area figures once the official regulatory plan is published.

official_data_gap.description: Official detailed planning conditions not in cleared public package; gaps do not block content scoring.

urban_fragmentation_hypothesis.description: Design hypothesis pending on-site verification: the living / R&D / showcase segments of AI talent and industry are spatially severed by the railway and expressways. No reviewed public source for current traffic, walkability, industry or public-service baselines was available in the cleared package; the open-call task book cannot serve as evidence of existing site conditions. Treated explicitly as a design hypothesis, not an established site fact, until an on-site survey or reviewed baseline source is obtained.
urban_fragmentation_hypothesis.recalculation_trigger: On-site survey or reviewed baseline data on traffic / walkability / industry
